{{Quote|Anyone with sympathy for the Separatist Cause should spend a few days in Pelek Baw. See what the Confederacy is really fighting for. It's good that Jedi do not indulge in hate.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint (novel)">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
'''Pelek Baw''' was the [[Balawai]]-controlled [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], the sole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Al'Har system]], and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Pelek Baw was the main metropolitan area on the planet, a stark contrast to its jungles where prospectors and [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] roamed free. As of [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it had a population of over 400,000, and spanned several kilometers.

It was located on the [[Korunnal Highland]], alongside the [[Great Downrush]] and just to the north of [[Downrush Falls]]. The [[City/Legends|city's]] locations included the [[Highland Green Washeteria]], the [[Ministry of Justice (Balawai)|Ministry of Justice]] building, and a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] located next to its warehouse district. The city was loyal to the planet's [[Representative Council]].

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Pelek Baw was controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], until Mace Windu traveled there to rescue the rogue Jedi Master [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]]. His mission triggered the [[Battle of Haruun Kal/Legends|Battle of Haruun Kal]], upon which the planet, and Pelek Baw with it, changed hands to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the battle, a permanent garrison of [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] remained in the city to serve as military [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]].
